title: Label-Free Segmentation of COVID-19 Lesions in Lung CT

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Label-Free Segmentation of COVID-19 Lesions in Lung CT》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Scarcity of annotated images hampers the building of automated solution for reliable COVID-19 diagnosis and evaluation from CT.

evidence.text: Scarcity of annotated images hampers the building of automated solution for reliable COVID-19 diagnosis and evaluation from CT.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Label-Free Segmentation of COVID-19 Lesions in Lung CT》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】To facilitate the learning of such patterns at a voxel level, we synthesize 'lesions' using a set of simple operations and insert the synthesized 'lesions' into normal CT lung scans to form training pairs, from which we learn a normalcy-recognizing network (NormNet) that recognizes normal tissues and separate them from possible COVID-19 lesions.

evidence.text: To facilitate the learning of such patterns at a voxel level, we synthesize 'lesions' using a set of simple operations and insert the synthesized 'lesions' into normal CT lung scans to form training pairs, from which we learn a normalcy-recognizing network (NormNet) that recognizes normal tissues and separate them from possible COVID-19 lesions.
